# Outer Wilds clue dependency map / 星际拓荒通关线索图

> A prerequisite graph for the Outer Wilds base game (Mobius Digital, 2019; no Echoes of the Eye DLC). To reach the ending you need three things: the Eye of the Universe's coordinates, the Nomai Vessel, and the advanced warp core. Each node lists what you must learn or reach first, where the clue is, other ways through, and how to get to key locations. Full spoilers.
> 《星际拓荒》本体线索依赖图：结局需要的三样东西、每一步的前置线索与地点、其他走法，以及关键地点怎么去。全剧透。

- English page: https://wangyufeng.org/outer-wilds-clues/en/
- 中文页面：https://wangyufeng.org/outer-wilds-clues/
- Machine-readable graph (nodes, prerequisites, quotes in English and Chinese): https://wangyufeng.org/outer-wilds-clues/graph.json
- Author: 王雨峰 (Wang Yufeng), https://wangyufeng.org/ · Published 2026-10-14
- Sources: official game text (English + Simplified Chinese, Steam build Oct 2026); alternatives from the Outer Wilds Wiki and community guides. Please link the page when citing.

## FAQ (English)

### What do you need to reach the ending of Outer Wilds?

Three things: the Eye of the Universe’s coordinates (in the Probe Tracking Module at the core of Giant’s Deep), the Nomai Vessel (stuck deep in Dark Bramble), and the advanced warp core (in the central chamber of the Ash Twin Project). Put the core in the Vessel, enter the coordinates on the bridge, and warp to the Eye. Taking the core stops the time loop, so do it last.

### Where is the Vessel in Dark Bramble and how do you get in?

Use the signalscope’s distress frequency to find Escape Pod 3 and follow the survivors’ lights to the Nomai Grave. The seed there only fits your scout; once inside, the tracker shows the scout in two places, and the other one is an unlit, ship-sized seed in the anglerfish nest. Slip past the anglerfish in the nest and take that seed to the Vessel.

### How do you get past the anglerfish in Dark Bramble?

Anglerfish are blind and hunt by sound, so cut your engines and drift. The clue is the anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin, where Nomai children played a game in which the “anglerfish” wore a blindfold. You leave each seed at a fixed speed and heading, so simply drifting works well.

### How do you get below Giant’s Deep’s current and through the electric field?

The intended way is to ride a counterclockwise cyclone down; the clue is the cyclone model in Brittle Hollow’s Southern Observatory. A very fast dive or a falling island also works. The electric field around the core can only be crossed inside a jellyfish; Feldspar’s notes in Dark Bramble say their rubbery skin insulates them.

### How do you get into the Ash Twin Project?

Its shell has no physical entrance, so you have to warp. The White Hole Station teaches how warp pads work; the tower designs in the High Energy Lab show where each tower goes; the Black Hole Forge says the Hourglass Twins share one alignment point between them. Put together: one tower on Ash Twin’s equator has its receiver at the planet’s center — stand on the pad inside it and wait for Ember Twin to pass overhead. The tower is buried in sand until about 7:50 into the loop.

### How do you get into the Sunless City and the High Energy Lab?

The Sunless City is beneath Ember Twin: follow the wall markers from the caves under Escape Pod 2, or drop through a hidden hole above the gravity cannon, before the sand fills it. The High Energy Lab’s front door is locked from inside; take the trail along the power cable from the city’s lowest district, early enough that the first half isn’t flooded and late enough that sand has buried the cacti on the second half.

### How do you reach the Black Hole Forge and the Southern Observatory?

The Forge hangs below the Hanging City: raise it from the control room in the Meltwater District, then warp to the Forge District from the Brittle Hollow tower on Ash Twin (the shaft is broken). The Southern Observatory’s surface door is broken; go under the crust, either from the gravity cannon across a chain of gravity lifts or from the base of the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.

### How do you reach the Quantum Moon’s sixth location?

You need all three quantum rules: imaging (Tower of Quantum Trials on Giant’s Deep), entanglement (Lakebed Cave on Ember Twin), and the sixth location (Tower of Quantum Knowledge on Brittle Hollow: the shrine must be at the moon’s north pole). Shut yourself in the shrine in the dark to travel with it; get it to the north pole and use it once more to meet Solanum.

### What happened to the Nomai?

After the Sun Station failed, the Nomai went to study a newly arrived comet, the Interloper. Its core held ghost matter under extreme pressure; when it ruptured, the ghost matter covered the solar system almost instantly. It is invisible to the eye but shows up on camera.

## One loop (English)

- Timber Hearth: 0:00 Wake up by the campfire
- Giant’s Deep: 0:18 The Orbital Probe Cannon fires — a flash in the sky
- Hourglass Twins: Lakebed Cave: open only for the first few minutes; 2:00 Sand starts to flow; 5:00 Sun Station tower door clears; 7:50 ~7:50 the project tower is uncovered; The Sunless City fills with sand from the bottom up
- Brittle Hollow: The crust keeps collapsing: the Tower of Quantum Knowledge and the gravity cannon fall into the black hole
- The Interloper: Swings around the Sun; the closer it gets, the wider the sunward fissure opens; 20:00 ~20:00 crashes into the Sun
- The Sun: Orange star; the Sun Station still stands; Swells into a red giant; 10:30 ~10.5–12 min: the Sun Station is swallowed; 20:30 Final minute or two: “End Times” plays; 22:00 Supernova — the loop starts over

## Who points you where (English)

- Timber Hearth village (Hal, Hornfels and the others): → Gabbro’s Island: "Hal says Gabbro went back to Giant’s Deep to try to learn more about the Nomai statue in the observatory." → Esker’s Camp: "Sounds like Esker is still stationed on the Attlerock. They’ve been there by themself for a while." → Eye Signal Locator: "I hear there are Nomai ruins somewhere on the Attlerock. No one knows what they are or why they were built. The Nomai text in the observatory talks about calibrating some sort of device on the Attlerock."
- Esker (the Attlerock): → Dark Bramble Seed: "Esker's signalscope log reports harmonica music coming from somewhere on Timber Hearth. They claim it sounds just like Feldspar's harmonica, but Feldspar disappeared in space ages ago." → Lunar Lookout: "Esker says the Attlerock’s north pole (marked in red on my minimap) is a great spot to listen for the other travelers’ music with a signalscope."
- Chert (Ember Twin): → Escape Pod 2: "Chert saw a Nomai shipwreck shooting a beam of light into the sky somewhere on Ember Twin's southern hemisphere." → The Sunless City: "Chert thinks the lack of surface ruins means the Nomai must have lived somewhere underground."
- Riebeck (Brittle Hollow): → Southern Observatory: "Riebeck says you can't get into the observatory from the surface (they tried), but there's probably a path to it beneath the crust somewhere."
- Gabbro (Giant’s Deep): → Ocean Depths: "Gabbro says there’s a strong current beneath the surface of the ocean that prevents anything from sinking below it." → Statue Island: "One of the islands on Giant’s Deep has a Nomai statue on the beach just like the one Gabbro brought back to Timber Hearth. Statue Island (as Gabbro calls it) is the one with two islands connected by a natural rock arch." → Orbital Probe Cannon: "Gabbro sees a bright flash in the sky at the start of every loop. Something must be happening in orbit around Giant’s Deep."
- Feldspar (Dark Bramble): → Frozen Jellyfish: "Feldspar hinted that a secret to reaching the core of Giant's Deep lies at the end of the hollow vine they crashed their ship into. To find Feldspar's ship, I'll want to go to the tail end of the anglerfish skeleton and look for a flickering light in the fog."

## Tools and abilities (English)

- Launch codes (Hornfels at the observatory): Ride the lift up the launch tower; Unlocks dozing at campfires
- Little Scout (Launcher on your suit): A photo pins a quantum object in place; Peek through small seeds; Its tracker shows it in two places at once; Its camera sees ghost matter; Light up the fossil’s mouth
- Signalscope (Starts with the Travelers frequency; learns others near their sources): Travelers: follow the harmonica to Feldspar; Distress Beacon: appears after your first escape pod, leads to Escape Pod 3; Quantum Fluctuations: shards and the Quantum Moon; Find the travelers’ instruments at the Eye
- Translator (Standard gear): Read Nomai spiral text and recordings — nearly every clue depends on it
- Flashlight (Your suit): Turn it off for total darkness and you become entangled; Lights out in the shrine to move with the moon
- Suit and jetpack (By the launch tower): Jump between misaligned gravity lifts; Too weak for Giant’s Deep’s gravity on high ledges
- Ship and ship log (Timber Hearth launch tower): Cut the engines and drift past anglerfish; The log records every clue and rumor; the question marks in rumor mode are places you haven’t been
- Campfire (On every planet): Doze to skip time, e.g. until the sand drains; Meditate to end the loop early: from the third loop, ask Gabbro how they stay so calm; Roast marshmallows to heal
- Nomai devices (All over the system): Warp pads: wait for the target overhead; Gravity cannons: recall a shuttle; Projection pools: see far-off places, like the sunken tracking module

## Endings (English)

- The Eye of the Universe (Main ending): Put the project’s core in the Vessel, enter the coordinates, warp → Walk from the north pole to the south, drop into the crater in the quantum storm, arrive at a quantum observatory → Light a campfire in the glade, find each traveler’s instrument with the signalscope, and play together → If you met Solanum she joins too, and the post-credits shot gains a new campfire with alien campers. Line: "But I think the rules are about to change."
- Stay at the sixth location (Hidden ending): Take the project’s core; the loop stops → Land on the Quantum Moon, go to its sixth location, wait for the supernova. Line: "HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN HERE? MINUTES? YEARS? YOU ARE UNSURE BUT IT SEEMS YOUR JOURNEY HAS REACHED ITS END."
- Adrift (Hidden ending): Take the project’s core → Fly far enough from the Sun to outrun the supernova. Line: "NOW BEYOND THE REACH OF THE SUPERNOVA, YOU DRIFT THROUGH SPACE UNTIL YOUR SHIP'S RESOURCES ARE FINALLY DEPLETED"
- Breaking spacetime (Hidden ending): In the High Energy Lab, fit a black hole core and a white hole core and fire your scout into the black hole → After it comes out of the white hole but before it goes in, pull a core: now two scouts exist. Line: "YOU DESTROYED THE FABRIC OF SPACETIME"
- Meeting yourself (Hidden ending): As the supernova hits, jump into the black hole that opens at the center of the Ash Twin Project → Next loop another you is waiting in the project; skip the jump this time and spacetime breaks. Line: "Are you me from the last loop?"
- Game over (Death): Die before the statue pairs with you, and the game starts over → Die after taking the project’s core, and you don’t wake up. Line: "YOU ARE DEAD"

## 常见问题（中文）

### 《星际拓荒》要打出结局，需要凑齐哪几样东西？

三样：宇宙之眼的坐标（在深巨星核心的探测器跟踪模块里）、挪麦人的飞船（困在黑棘星深处）、高级跃迁核心（在灰烬双星计划的中央舱室里）。把核心装进飞船，在舰桥输入坐标，就能跃迁到宇宙之眼。取出核心会让时间循环停止，所以这一步要放在最后。

### 飞船在黑棘星哪里，怎么进去？

先用信号镜的求救信号频道找到3号逃生舱，顺着幸存者留下的灯走到挪麦坟墓。坟墓前那颗种子太小，只能射侦察兵进去；进去后追踪器显示侦察兵同时在两个地方，另一处就是安康鱼巢里一颗不发光的大种子。穿过鱼巢的安康鱼，从那颗种子进去就是飞船。

### 黑棘星的安康鱼怎么躲？

安康鱼是瞎的，靠声音找猎物，关掉引擎靠惯性滑过去就不会被发现。线索在余烬双星的安康鱼化石：挪麦小孩玩"安康鱼和小鱼"时，扮安康鱼的要戴眼罩。从种子出来时速度方向固定，什么都不按直接漂也很稳。

### 怎么潜到深巨星的水流下面、穿过核心外的电场？

设计好的办法是坐逆时针旋转的气旋下去，线索在碎空星南部天文台的气旋模型。也能高速直冲，或停在被抛起的岛下面等它砸下来。核心外的电场只能钻进水母穿过，线索是黑棘星里费尔德斯巴吃水母的笔记：外皮像橡胶，能绝缘。

### 灰烬双星计划怎么进去？

保护外壳没有任何物理入口，只能跃迁。白洞站教你跃迁平台的用法；高能实验室的高塔设计图对应每座塔的去向；黑洞熔炉说明沙漏双星共用两星之间的对准点。合起来就知道：灰烬双星赤道上有一座塔的接收点在星球中心，站在那座塔里的平台上，等余烬双星经过头顶就会被传进去。那座塔一开始埋在沙里，大约第 7 分 50 秒才进得去。

### 背阴城和高能实验室怎么进？

背阴城在余烬双星地下：从2号逃生舱下的洞穴跟着墙上的路标走，或从重力炮上方的隐藏洞口下去，要趁沙子还没灌满。高能实验室正门从里面锁着，只能从背阴城最底层沿能量电缆的小路过去，前半段怕沙子淹，后半段要等沙子盖住仙人掌。

### 黑洞熔炉和南部天文台怎么去？

黑洞熔炉挂在悬空城下面，先在融水区的控制室把它升到最上层，再从灰烬双星上的碎空星塔跃迁到熔炉区（竖井断了）。南部天文台的地面大门是坏的，要从地壳下走：从重力炮出发跳一串重力电梯，或从量子知识之塔底层出发。

### 量子卫星的第六个位置怎么去？

要用齐三条量子法则：成像法则（深巨星量子试验之塔）、纠缠法则（余烬双星湖床洞穴）、第六位置法则（碎空星量子知识之塔：祭坛必须在卫星北极）。在祭坛里关门关灯就会随它移动，让祭坛出现在北极后再用一次，就能见到所莱内姆。

### 挪麦人是怎么灭绝的？

太阳站没能引爆太阳后，挪麦人去调查刚到的彗星"闯入者"。彗星核心里是高压的幽灵物质，外壳破裂后几乎一瞬间覆盖了整个星系。幽灵物质肉眼看不见，用相机能看到。

## 一个循环（中文）

- 木炉星：在营火边醒来
- 深巨星：轨道探测炮发射，天上一闪
- 沙漏双星：湖床洞穴只在开头几分钟能进；沙子开始流动；太阳站塔门露出；约 7:50 通往计划的塔露出；背阴城从下往上被沙灌满
- 碎空星：地壳被火山弹陆续砸塌：量子知识之塔、重力炮先后掉进黑洞
- 闯入者：绕太阳飞，越近太阳，向阳面的冰缝开得越大；约第 20 分钟撞进太阳
- 太阳：橙色恒星，太阳站还在；膨胀成红巨星；约 10.5–12 分钟太阳站被吞没；最后一两分钟响起《End Times》；超新星，循环重来

## 谁给你指的路（中文）

- 木炉星村子（哈尔、霍恩费斯等人）：→ 加布罗的岛屿：“哈尔说加布罗打算回到深巨星，对天文台的挪麦雕像作进一步的调查。” → 埃斯科的营地：“听起来埃斯科依然驻扎在废岩星。他已经在那儿独自待了好一阵子了。” → 宇宙之眼信号定位器：“我听说废岩星上有挪麦人的废墟。没人知道它们是干什么用的，也不知道挪麦人为什么要造它们。天文台里的挪麦文字提到，挪麦人正在对废岩星上的某种设备进行校准。”
- 埃斯科（废岩星）：→ 黑棘星种子：“埃斯科的信号镜日志报告说，木炉星的某处传来了口琴声。他说那声音听起来和费尔德斯巴的口琴一模一样。可是费尔德斯巴早就消失在太空里了。” → 月面瞭望所：“埃斯科说废岩星的北极（在我的小地图上用红色标出）非常适合用信号镜去聆听其他旅行者演奏的音乐。”
- 切特（余烬双星）：→ 2号逃生舱：“切特看见一艘挪麦宇宙飞船残骸向余烬双星南半球的某个地方发射了一道光束。” → 背阴城：“切特觉得地表很少有废墟这个事实，说明挪麦人一定住在地下的什么地方。”
- 瑞拜克（碎空星）：→ 南部天文台：“根据瑞拜克的说法，从地面进入天文台是不可能的（他试过了），不过地壳下某个地方可能有条通路。”
- 加布罗（深巨星）：→ 海洋深处：“加布罗说水面下有一股很强劲的水流，使得水里的东西无法沉下去。” → 雕像岛：“深巨星某些岛屿的海滩上有挪麦雕像，这是其中的一座。这些雕像就和加布罗带回到木炉星的那个没什么两样。雕像岛（加布罗是这么称呼它的）就在两座由天然石拱门连接的岛屿那里。” → 轨道探测炮：“加布罗在每个循环开始时，总会在天空中看到一道明亮的闪光。深巨星的轨道上一定发生了什么事情。”
- 费尔德斯巴（黑棘星）：→ 冻住的水母：“费尔德斯巴提示说，抵达深巨星核心的秘密就藏在他的飞船坠毁的那棵空心藤蔓尽头里。我要去安康鱼骨架的尾巴那里，在迷雾里寻找闪烁的光亮，才能发现费尔德斯巴的飞船。”

## 工具与能力（中文）

- 发射密码（天文台的霍恩费斯）：坐升降梯上发射台；拿到之后，营火边才能打盹
- 侦察兵（宇航服上的发射器）：拍下的照片能定住量子物体；射进小种子看里面；追踪器显示它同时在两个地方；相机能看到幽灵物质；当灯照亮化石的嘴
- 信号镜（自带旅行者频道，其他频道靠近信号源时学会）：旅行者频道：循着口琴声找到费尔德斯巴；求救信号：找到第一个逃生舱后出现，带你找到3号逃生舱；量子波动：量子碎片和量子卫星；在宇宙之眼找回旅行者们的乐器
- 翻译器（随身装备）：读懂挪麦人的螺旋文字和记录：几乎每条线索都靠它
- 手电筒（宇航服）：关掉它，完全黑暗：和量子物体纠缠在一起；在祭坛里关灯，随卫星换位置
- 宇航服与喷气背包（发射台旁）：在错位的重力电梯之间跳；深巨星重力太大，高处够不着
- 飞船与飞船日志（木炉星发射台）：关掉引擎，靠惯性滑过安康鱼；飞船日志记下每条线索和传闻，传闻模式里的问号就是还没去的地方
- 营火（每颗星球上都有）：打盹快进时间，等沙子流走；冥想直接结束这一轮：第三轮起问加布罗"你怎么能这么冷静"就能学会；烤棉花糖回血
- 挪麦设施（散落在各颗星球）：跃迁平台：等对应天体过头顶；重力炮：召回航天飞机；投影池：看到远处的场景，比如沉在海底的跟踪模块

## 结局图鉴（中文）

- 宇宙之眼（正常结局）：把计划的核心装进飞船，输入坐标，跃迁 → 从北极走到南极，跳进量子风暴中心的坑，回到一座量子版的天文台 → 在林地里生起营火，用信号镜把旅行者们的乐器一个个找回来，一起演奏 → 见过所莱内姆的话，她也会加入；片尾的新宇宙里会多出一圈围着营火的外星人。原文："不过我觉得规则就快变了。"
- 留在第六个位置（隐藏结局）：取下计划的核心，循环停止 → 登上量子卫星，去它的第六个位置，等超新星。原文："你在这儿待了有多久了？几分钟？还是几年？对此你并不清楚，但你的旅途似乎已经到达了终点。"
- 飘向深空（隐藏结局）：取下计划的核心 → 开飞船飞得足够远，躲过超新星。原文："你已经再也无法到达超新星，只能在太空中飘荡，直到宇宙飞船的资源耗尽"
- 打破时空（隐藏结局）：在高能实验室装上黑洞核心和白洞核心，把侦察兵射进黑洞 → 侦察兵从白洞出来之后、进黑洞之前，拔掉一个核心：两个侦察兵同时存在。原文："你摧毁了时空结构"
- 遇见自己（隐藏结局）：超新星爆发时，跳进灰烬双星计划中心张开的黑洞 → 下一轮计划里会多出一个你；这一轮不再跳一次，就会打破时空。原文："你是上一个循环的我自己吗？"
- 游戏结束（死亡）：雕像和你配对之前就死了，游戏从头开始 → 取下计划的核心之后死掉，不会再醒来。原文："你死了"

    - [意识到] 它会在五个位置之间跳 — 余烬双星 · 量子卫星定位器

  - [意识到] 成像法则 — 观察图像 = 观察本体 (以下任选一)
    - [探索到] 量子试验之塔 — 深巨星北极

        - [意识到] 深巨星有量子信号 — 信号镜 · 量子频道
        - [探索到] 绕过北极的巨型气旋 (以下任选一)
          - [探索到] 从云层上方降进去
          - [探索到] 从水流下面浮上去
    - [运气 / 试错 / 硬闯] 自己试出拍照能定住它 — 任意量子物体
  - [意识到] 纠缠法则 — 站在量子物体上，完全黑暗 (以下任选一)
    - [意识到] 科利耶斯消失之谜 — 余烬双星 · 湖床洞穴

        - 循环开头几分钟内去 [时间窗口]

  - [意识到] 第六位置法则 — 祭坛必须在卫星北极
    - [探索到] 量子知识之塔 — 碎空星赤道

# Additional topic sections / 新增板块

Nomai people: nomai/graph.json · evidence: nomai/evidence.html · verification: nomai/verification.html
Echoes of the Eye: dlc/graph.json · complete original context: dlc/evidence.html

The base-game dependency dataset above retains its scope. The Nomai and DLC datasets have separate semantics.
本体、人物关系、DLC是同页独立板块，不把历史因果或同项目参加误作通关硬前置或人物直接交往。

## 01 找到外星站 / 01 Find the Stranger
### 新展品 → 无线电塔 / New exhibit → Radio Tower
新展品把你引向接收深空卫星照片的无线电塔。三张照片里只有一张多出异常黑影，霍恩费斯一度怀疑设备损坏。
The new exhibit points to the Radio Tower. Only one of its three satellite photos shows an extra silhouette; Hornfels initially suspects the equipment.
加布罗检查镜头，确认没有灰尘、划痕或故障迹象。这是重新观察照片的理由，不是另一颗新行星的坐标。
Gabbro finds no dust, scratches or fault. This motivates another observation; it does not give you coordinates for a new planet.
Source IDs: TH_RADIO_TOWER_X1, DLG:Gabbro_SatelliteNote:Everything looks a-okay

### 复现约40°的异常照片 / Recreate the photograph at about 40°
跟随卫星，观察其角度显示；接近照片所示的40°时朝太阳看，会看到遮挡太阳的轮廓。向它飞近，穿过隐蔽力场。
Follow the satellite and its angle display. Near the photographed 40° alignment, look toward the Sun for the silhouette, then fly toward it and through the cloak.
40°是方便找到目标的观察位置，不是解锁外星站的开关；知道位置后可以直接飞过去。
The alignment helps locate the station; it does not unlock it. Once its position is known, you can fly straight there.
Source IDs: IP_RING_WORLD_X1

### 进入人工环形世界 / Enter an artificial ring world
用灯光操作入口，进入环形河流。主要区域是河流洼地、余烬群岛、隐藏峡谷和水库；木筏靠照亮操纵装置行驶。
Use light to operate the entrance. The river links the River Lowlands, Cinder Isles, Hidden Gorge and Reservoir; light operates the rafts.
这是另一支文明建造的世界，翻译器无法读懂他们的文字。通过幻灯片和视觉记录理解这里，再结合飞船日志整理发现。
This world was built by another civilization, whose writing your translator cannot read. Learn through slide reels and visions, then use the ship log to connect your discoveries.
Source IDs: IP_RING_WORLD_X1, IP_ZONE_1_X1, IP_ZONE_2_X1, IP_ZONE_3_X1, IP_ZONE_4_X2

## 02 文物、绿火与梦境 / 02 Artifact, green fire and the dream
### 取得可用的文物 / Find a working Artifact
车间内有可用文物。先用侦察兵拍照确认幽灵物质分布，沿安全入口取走；幽灵物质不是肉眼可见的绿色火焰。
The workshop contains working Artifacts. Use Scout photographs to check the ghost matter and take a safe entrance; ghost matter is distinct from green fire.
文物能聚光，也能遮住自己的光。普通提灯无法代替文物；实验室里会爆炸的失败原型也不能用来连接梦境。
The working Artifact can focus and conceal its light. The lab also contains failed prototypes; neither an ordinary lantern nor an explosive prototype substitutes for it.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_1_X2, IP_ZONE_3_ENTRANCE_X3

### 实验记录教你如何连接 / The laboratory shows how to connect
峡谷的卷盘指出外壳爆炸破洞。可从外部破洞进入第二测试间，查看三种原型实验和绿火前入睡的视觉记录。
A reel in the gorge reveals the explosion and hull breach. Enter the second chamber from outside to study three prototype experiments and the vision of sleeping at a green fire.
第三次实验似乎成功，记录给出的使用方法是在绿火旁入睡。如果你已经自行试出这个方法，可以直接进入梦境。
The third experiment appears successful. The lab teaches the method; it is not a mandatory lock if you discover the method yourself.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_3_ENTRANCE_R1, IP_ZONE_3_ENTRANCE_X1, IP_ZONE_3_ENTRANCE_X2, IP_ZONE_3_ENTRANCE_X3

### 打开壁画后的绿火房间 / Open the green-fire rooms
岛屿高塔的卷盘显示：移走圆形房间里的提灯，使特定壁画不再被照亮，出现通道。居民的身体在绿火旁。
The Island Tower reel shows lanterns being removed from a circular mural room, leaving a particular mural dark and opening a passage. Bodies sit around the green fire.
三处村落各通往一片梦境区域；水库沉没构筑物里的绿火通往地下湖内部。记住现实身体留在哪间房。
The three settlement rooms lead to three dream regions. The Reservoir fire leads inside the submerged structure above the lake. Remember where your physical body remains.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_2_LIGHTHOUSE_X1, IP_PRISON_X1, IP_PRISON_X2

### 手持文物，在绿火旁入睡 / Sleep at a green fire holding the Artifact
持可用文物在绿火附近打盹，醒来进入对应梦境；此处的文物已亮起。聚光可操作装置，遮光可隐藏自己的光。
Doze near a green fire while holding a working Artifact. You arrive in its dream region with the Artifact lit. Focus operates mechanisms; conceal hides your light.
梦境内火焰熄灭通常使活着的身体醒来；现实身体的火焰被洪水熄灭也会断开连接。梦境区域可由河流木筏互通。
Losing the dream flame normally wakes a living body. Floodwater extinguishing the physical flame also disconnects you. Dream regions are linked by rafts.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_3_ENTRANCE_X2, IP_DREAM_ZONE_1_R1, IP_DREAM_ZONE_2_R1, IP_DREAM_ZONE_3_R1

## 03 从密封储藏库追到焚片室 / 03 Follow the vault’s trail
### 到地下湖看见三道封印 / Reach the lake and its three seals
从现实水下构筑物的底部开口游入，带文物在内部绿火旁入睡，再沿梦境里的楼梯和升降机下到地下湖。
Swim into the physical structure from underneath. Sleep at its green fire with the Artifact, then take the dream stairs and elevator down to the lake.
现实里的箱体和梦境里岸边的储藏库不是同一套可直接打开的门。梦境岸边有三道封印、三组控制装置。
The physical container and dream vault are not doors you open in the same way. The dream shore has three seals and three control interfaces.
Source IDs: IP_PRISON_X1, IP_PRISON_X2, IP_DREAM_LAKE_X1

### 尝试开门，接住漏出的光 / Try the vault and receive its vision
转动储藏库前的机关。链条拉住门，片刻后绿光漏出；光中的记忆指向岛屿高塔上层壁画房间。
Turn the vault mechanism. The chains hold the door shut; light leaks out after a moment. Its vision points to the mural room high in the Island Tower.
顺着记忆去找高塔里的房间，就能继续追查封印的线索，无须穷举密码。
This is a clue to your next investigation, not an instruction to brute-force three codes.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_LAKE_X2, IP_ZONE_2_CODE_R1

### 在梦境吹灭蜡烛，现实灯才灭 / Extinguish dream candles to darken the real mural
高塔背面入口通往上层。梦境中点亮通向塔后入口的路径，进入对应壁画房，吹灭两侧蜡烛；醒来查看现实中的暗壁画。
Use the tower’s rear entrance for its upper floor. In the dream, project the route to its rear entrance and extinguish the corresponding mural-room candles. Wake and inspect the now-dark physical mural.
符号室三份封印内容已烧毁；焚片符号和控制室符号的序列还在。焚片序列才是追查档案馆的入口。
Three vault-code containers are burned. The slide-burning and control-room sequences remain. The slide-burning sequence advances the archive investigation.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_2_LIGHTHOUSE_X2, IP_DREAM_ZONE_2_X4, IP_ZONE_2_CODE_X1, IP_ZONE_2_CODE_X2, IP_ZONE_2_CODE_X3

### 用焚片符号打开遗弃神庙 / Use the slide-burning code in the temple
从峡谷侧面的通道进入神庙，而不是跨断桥。楼上输入符号室取得的序列，打开神庙地下密室。
Enter the temple via the gorge passage rather than the broken bridge. Enter the Symbol Room sequence upstairs to open the chamber below.
记录显示居民曾扫描卷盘，再焚毁实体幻灯片；这里的地图投影标出三处隐藏焚片室。
A reel shows the inhabitants scanning reels before destroying physical slides. The map projections locate three concealed slide-burning rooms.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_3_LAB_X1, IP_ZONE_3_LAB_X3, IP_ZONE_3_LAB_X4, IP_ZONE_3_LAB_X2, IP_MAP_PROJECTION_1_X1, IP_MAP_PROJECTION_2_X1, IP_MAP_PROJECTION_3_X1

### 三处焚片室 → 三个隐藏入口 / Three burning rooms → three hidden entrances
按投影分别找回隐藏卷盘：洼地卷盘画出森林音乐屋的壁炉；群岛卷盘画出熄灯后的井；峡谷卷盘画出熄灯后的树形壁画。
Follow each projection to a hidden reel: the Lowlands reel shows a forest lodge fireplace, the Isles reel a darkened well, and the gorge reel a tree mural in darkness.
三卷记录分别给出一座档案馆的入口。你可以按任意顺序探索三馆，从完整档案中寻找解封方法。
These reveal archive entrances. The forest, cove and canyon have no mandatory visit order, and you are not collecting intact vault passwords.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_1_SECRET_X1, IP_ZONE_2_SECRET_X1, IP_ZONE_3_SECRET_X1

## 04 三座档案馆，三种机制 / 04 Three archives, three mechanisms
### 覆盖林地：从壁炉后进入 / Shrouded Woodlands: behind the fireplace
跟随绿灯与音乐找到森林深处的集会屋；档案馆在屋内壁炉后。居民还在时会阻拦，不能只盯着火焰找开关。
Follow the lights and music to the gathering house. Its archive is behind the fireplace. The inhabitants obstruct access while present; the fire itself is not a switch puzzle.
先打开这里通往木筏的路，再从不会被同一波洪水淹没的另一绿火房间进入，乘梦境木筏回来。洼地被淹后，屋内居民随现实火焰熄灭而消失。
Open the raft access first, then enter through another physical fire room unaffected by that flood and raft back. After the Lowlands flood, the occupants vanish as their physical flames go out.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_1_R1, IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_1_X1, IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_1_X2

### 星光海湾：熄灯后下井 / Starlit Cove: darken the well
按卷盘线索找到区域的熄灯装置，关闭照亮井口的灯，再遮住文物的光越过警铃哨兵，下井绕开巡逻者抵达档案馆。
Find the area’s extinguishing mechanism, darken the well, then conceal your Artifact while passing the sentry. Descend and get around the patrolling inhabitants to reach the archive.
只有自己藏光并不足以穿过仍被环境灯照亮的哨兵通路。这里学习的死亡机制可用于之后回访，但不是必须预先知道才能初次进馆。
Concealing your light alone will not help on a path still illuminated externally. The death mechanism taught here enables a later shortcut; it is not required knowledge for a first visit.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_ZONE_2_X2, IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_2_R1, IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_2_X1, IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_2_X2

### 无尽峡谷：暗处穿过树形壁画 / Endless Canyon: through the dark tree mural
找到通往熄灯装置的隐蔽路线，熄灭旅馆灯光；之后通向底层树形壁画。内部桥会随熄灯消失，需重新点亮或改从码头升降机侧进入。
Find the hidden route to the extinguishing mechanism and darken the lodge. Reach the tree mural below; the interior bridge goes out with the lights, so relight it or approach from the dock elevator.
点亮内部桥的常规路线需要绕开居民；也可事先把升降机降到码头，熄灯后从另一绿火房间乘筏回来。后者减少潜行，不保证门前完全无人。
The normal internal-bridge route involves evading inhabitants. Alternatively, lower the dock elevator first and return by raft after darkening the lodge. This reduces stealth, not every possible encounter.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_ZONE_3_X2, IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_3_R1, IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_3_X1, IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_3_X2

### 机制一：过渡黑暗中离开木筏 / Mechanism 1: leave the raft in a transition
错误报告显示居民在区域切换的黑暗过渡中跳离木筏，落到模拟世界下方。普通露天河段跳水只会熄灭文物，不能替代这个条件。
The error report shows a passenger leaving a raft during the dark transition and falling beneath the simulation. Jumping into an ordinary open river extinguishes the Artifact instead.
这提供从下层接近地下湖和一处封印的方法；也能用于重新访问部分档案馆。
This opens access to the lower lake and a seal, and can also shorten later archive visits.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_1_RULE_X1

### 机制二：死亡也能连接，警铃叫不醒 / Mechanism 2: death connects; bells cannot wake the dead
一卷显示入睡和死亡都能点亮文物；另一卷显示警铃无法唤醒已死的现实身体。持可用文物，在绿火范围内死亡，仍可进入模拟世界。
One reel shows both sleep and death lighting the Artifact. Another shows bells failing to wake a dead physical body. Dying within range of green fire while holding a working Artifact can still connect you.
可站到绿火上实现；不是让失败原型爆炸。身体死后不能再靠警铃返回现实，探索时仍要保护文物火焰。
Standing in the green fire is one way; an exploding failed prototype is not a substitute. Bells cannot return a dead body to life, and your Artifact flame still needs protection.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X1, IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X2

### 机制三：离开文物的投影范围 / Mechanism 3: walk beyond the Artifact’s projection
放下点亮的文物，走得足够远，看到简化的绿色模拟结构；平常看不见的平台和路径在这里显露。
Set down the lit Artifact and walk beyond its projection radius to see the simplified green structure, including paths and platforms normally invisible.
这不是关闭整座模拟世界。文物留在原处；看清路线后仍要按需要取回它，才能使用照光／熄火装置。
This does not turn off the simulation. The Artifact remains where you left it; retrieve it when light-operated mechanisms require it.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_3_RULE_X1

## 05 用机制解开三道封印 / 05 Apply the mechanisms to three seals
### 渡筏封印：从世界下方接近 / Raft seal: approach from beneath the world
带着文物，在连接区域的黑暗过渡中离开木筏，落到下层。沿可行走的下层路径到相应封印，熄灭它的火。
Take the Artifact off a raft during a dark transition to land below. Follow the lower route to the corresponding seal and extinguish its flame.
此方法绕过的是水面和渡行障碍；它不会顺便解除另外两道封印。
This bypasses the water-crossing obstacle; it does not disable the other two seals.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_1_RULE_X1, IP_DREAM_LAKE_X1

### 警铃封印：让现实身体听不到 / Alarm seal: remove the living body’s response
持可用文物在现实绿火范围内死亡后进入。警铃虽然会响，无法叫醒现实身体；走过通路，熄灭对应封印。
Connect by dying at the physical green fire with a working Artifact. The alarm still rings but cannot wake the body; cross the path and extinguish its seal.
这里有持续环境照明，仅遮住自己的文物解决不了问题。保持灰烬双星计划运行，仍能在记忆回传后开始下一循环。
The external lighting makes concealment alone insufficient. With the Ash Twin Project still active, memory transmission can still start your next loop.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X1, IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X2

### 隐桥封印：看见并对齐平台 / Bridge seal: reveal and align the platforms
把文物留在安全处，走出投影范围，观察控制装置如何改变平台位置。调整至连续可走的路径后，取回文物通过并熄灭封印。
Leave the Artifact somewhere safe, step beyond its projection, and observe how the interface moves the platforms. Align a walkable route, retrieve the Artifact, then cross and extinguish the seal.
看见平台结构后，就能直接调出可走的路径，即使封印密码已被烧毁也可以通过。
You need to see the geometry, not recover an intact code from destroyed slides.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_3_RULE_X1, IP_ZONE_2_CODE_X2

### 三道封印全灭 → 开门 / All three seals out → open the vault
确认三个发光封印都已熄灭，回到岸边转动开门机关。进入储藏库，向下抵达幽禁者所在处。
Check that all three glowing seals are extinguished and operate the shore mechanism. Enter and descend to the Prisoner.
你打开的是模拟世界中的储藏库。现实箱体依然封闭，居民的肉身不会复活，太阳也仍会走向超新星。
This releases a vault in the simulation; it does not open the physical container, revive a body, or stop the Sun.
Source IDs: IP_SARCOPHAGUS_X2, IP_DREAM_LAKE_X1

## 06 交换记忆，再决定如何告别 / 06 Exchange memories and say farewell
### 用视觉记忆互相讲述历史 / Share history through visions
幽禁者先展示自己为何被囚禁。你再用视觉火把分享本星系的故事，使他知道短暂释放的信号曾被接收到。
The Prisoner shows why they were confined. Use the vision torch to share your solar system’s history, letting them learn that the briefly released signal was heard.
为补全所展示的历史，建议先读旧定居点壁画或探索飞船，并调查闯入者核心。不必先通关本体；直接探索DLC也能相遇，但部分记忆片段会省略。
For a fuller vision, first investigate the Old Settlement murals or the Vessel, and the Interloper’s core. Completing the base ending is not required: a direct DLC playthrough can reach this encounter, but some historical scenes are omitted.
Source IDs: IP_SARCOPHAGUS_X3, IP_SARCOPHAGUS_X4, DLG:Prisoner_Eye_Campfire:I hadn’t dared to hope

### 水边最后的愿景 / The final vision at the water
幽禁者离开后，查看水边留下的视觉火把，观看最后的告别愿景。它不是一艘等待你实际登上的逃生船。
After the Prisoner leaves, inspect the vision torch at the water for their farewell. The vision is not an escape raft waiting for you to board.
脚印一直通向水中，暗示幽禁者熄灭了火焰，结束了自己在模拟世界中的存在。日志没有明确说明这一动作；水边的远航是告别愿景。
Footprints lead into the water. Ending their simulated existence is an implication of the scene, not an explicit spoken log entry or a voyage after physical revival.
Source IDs: IP_SARCOPHAGUS_X5

### 下一循环去眼，邀请他的记忆 / On a later loop, reach the Eye and invite their memory
完成相遇后，不必在同一循环逃回飞船。保持计划运行，下一轮按本体路线取得核心、带入飞船、输入眼坐标。
You do not need to escape to the ship in the same loop. Keep the Project active, then follow the base route on a later loop: core, Vessel and Eye coordinates.
眼中的幽禁者会询问你是否愿意记住他；可以邀请，也可以告别。相遇扩展了本体终局，不增加一套新的宇宙之眼坐标。
At the Eye, the Prisoner asks whether you want to remember them. You may invite them or say goodbye. The encounter enriches the ending without adding new Eye coordinates.
Source IDs: DLG:Prisoner_Eye_Choice:Are you certain you want to remember me, DLG:Prisoner_Eye_Choice:Join us. Let’s see what happens., DLG:Prisoner_Eye_Campfire:What comes next cannot be done alone

## 07 把被删去的历史接回本体 / 07 Reconnect the erased history
### 追随眼的信号，付出故乡的代价 / Follow the signal at the cost of home
未焚毁的卷盘补出建造外星站的牺牲：他们消耗故乡资源建造远行设施，离开环状行星旁的母星卫星。
The intact reel restores the sacrifice behind the Stranger: their home moon’s resources were consumed to build the vessel that took them away.
完整卷盘让你看清远行背后的代价。读完即可继续探索，不必携带卷盘去解封。
The intact reel reveals the cost of the journey. You can continue after reading it; the reel does not need to be carried to the vault.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_1_STORY_X1, IP_DREAM_1_STORY_X2

### 恐惧眼的力量，封锁信号 / Fear the Eye and block its signal
他们观察眼的力量后感到恐惧，建造并发射阻挡信号的装置。幽禁者在眼中的对白补充了这种拒绝结束的心态。
After observing the Eye’s power they became afraid, built a signal blocker and launched it. The Prisoner’s Eye dialogue adds their reluctance to let their story end.
卷盘呈现的是居民对宇宙之眼的恐惧。挪麦人的灭绝另有原因：闯入者内部释放的幽灵物质。
The reel depicts the inhabitants’ fear of the Eye. The Nomai died for a different reason: ghost matter released from the Interloper.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_2_STORY_X2, DLG:Prisoner_Eye_Choice:When my kind found the Eye

### 把失去的故乡重建为模拟世界 / Recreate their lost home in a simulation
完整卷盘说明梦境按他们的母星卫星重建。现实肉身死亡后，点亮的文物仍可维持连接；不等于真实故乡被复原。
The intact reel shows a simulation modeled on their home moon. Lit Artifacts can sustain a connection after physical death; the real home moon was not restored.
被焚毁的实体记录和模拟世界中的完整档案共同解释了为何玩家必须追查被隐藏的资料。
The burned physical records and intact simulated archives explain why the missing history must be recovered from hidden places.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_3_STORY_X2, IP_ZONE_3_LAB_X2, IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X1

### 短暂放开信号 → 被永久幽禁 / Briefly release the signal → imprisonment
幽禁者曾关闭阻挡装置，眼的信号短暂传出；其他居民重新封锁信号，并把他囚禁。封印密码随后被销毁。
The Prisoner briefly disabled the blocker. The others restored it and confined them; the seal codes were later destroyed.
幽禁者后来形容那次信号只持续了很短的时间，具体有多久并没有记载。
The Prisoner explicitly describes a brief release. Its exact duration is not stated.
Source IDs: IP_SARCOPHAGUS_X3, IP_ZONE_2_CODE_X2, DLG:Prisoner_Eye_Campfire:I hadn’t dared to hope

### 那次回声把两段故事连起来 / That brief echo connects both stories
玩家展示的记忆把信号、挪麦人的追寻、灭绝和哈斯人的探索连在一起。幽禁者终于知道自己的行动并未毫无结果。
Your vision connects the signal with the Nomai search, their extinction and Hearthian exploration. The Prisoner learns that their action was not in vain.
幽禁者释放信号、挪麦人追寻信号、哈斯人追查遗迹，发生在不同的时代。你的记忆让幽禁者第一次看见这些后续。
The Prisoner released the signal, the Nomai followed it, and the Hearthians explored their ruins in different eras. Your memories show the Prisoner what followed.
Source IDs: IP_SARCOPHAGUS_X4, DLG:Prisoner_Eye_Choice:my efforts weren’t in vain, DLG:Prisoner_Eye_Campfire:I hadn’t dared to hope

## 08 另外可走的路，不倒置初次线索 / 08 Alternatives without circular prerequisites
### 峡谷：先降升降机，再绕回码头 / Canyon: lower the elevator, return by raft
亮灯时走到内部桥另一侧，把码头升降机降下。返回熄灯装置关灯，离开梦境，从另一现实绿火房间重新进入，乘梦境木筏回峡谷。
With the lights on, cross the interior bridge and lower the dock elevator. Darken the lodge, leave the dream, re-enter through another physical fire and raft back to the canyon.
升降机把你带到树形壁画那一侧，绕过大段旅馆。无需预先知道投影范围机制；仍应观察底层居民的位置。
The elevator returns you to the mural side, bypassing much of the lodge. You do not need advance knowledge of projection radius; check inhabitants near the lower route.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_LIBRARY_3_R1

### 已知投影机制：峡谷隐桥回访 / Known projection mechanism: canyon bridge shortcut
如果已经发现离灯机制，可以先查看隐形桥，再取回文物沿记住的路径前往码头侧。树形壁画仍需要处于黑暗中。
If you already know the radius mechanism, reveal the hidden bridge, retrieve the Artifact and follow the remembered path toward the dock side. The tree mural must still be dark.
这条路适合已经知道投影机制后的回访。第一次进馆仍可走重亮内部桥或码头升降机的路线。
Use this shortcut once you know the projection mechanism. On your first visit, you can relight the interior bridge or return by the dock elevator.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_3_RULE_X1

### 已知死亡机制：海湾警铃回访 / Known death mechanism: revisit the cove
如果已自行试出死亡连接，或已经看过档案卷盘，可在绿火旁死亡后穿过警铃区域。它是替代进入方式，不是初次探索必须取得的能力。
If you independently discover death-connection or have seen its reel, enter after physical death and pass the alarm. It is an alternative route, not an ability required for the first visit.
死亡不能让你无视巡逻者或火焰熄灭；这两类障碍与警铃不同。
Death does not make you immune to inhabitants or an extinguished flame. Those are different hazards.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X1, IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X2

### 已知过渡机制：从下层回访森林档案 / Known transition mechanism: revisit from below
在正确过渡时机离筏到下层，可接近森林档案馆。普通跳河不行；只有首次已学会或偶然试出，才能把它作为你的路线。
Leaving a raft in the correct transition reaches the lower area near the forest archive. An ordinary river jump will not. This route assumes prior knowledge or independent discovery.
常规路线仍是从其他入口等待洼地火焰熄灭后返回；无需先靠捷径取得它自身的线索。
The regular route still works: return from another fire after the Lowlands flames go out. No shortcut is required to learn its own clue.
Source IDs: IP_DREAM_1_RULE_X1

### 阻挡器控制室不是第四道封印 / The blocker control room is not a fourth seal
符号室另有控制室序列，可查看水库控制室的烧毁界面和断开连接的投影。它补充历史与技术背景。
The Symbol Room also has a control-room sequence. Inside the Reservoir room are a burned interface and a disconnected-link projection, adding historical and technical context.
这里能补充阻挡器的背景。完成幽禁者相遇无须修复控制室，也无须关闭阻挡器或寻找新的眼坐标。
The room adds context about the blocker. Meeting the Prisoner does not require repairing the room, disabling the blocker, or finding new Eye coordinates.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_4_X3, IP_ZONE_2_CODE_X1

## 09 时间、循环与两种替代结局 / 09 Time, the loop and two alternative endings
### 洪水改变入口，现实身体决定断连 / The flood changes access; the physical body matters
约循环第13分钟大坝溃决，洼地绿火被淹；岛屿高塔更晚倒塌，约20分30秒。峡谷入口位于更高处，不会被同一波洪水淹没。
The dam breaks at roughly 13 minutes, flooding the Lowlands fire. The Island Tower falls later, around 20:30. The higher gorge fire is not flooded by the same wave.
时间为近似值。从洼地绿火入梦，你也会在洪水到来时断开连接。要等居民消失后继续探索，应先把现实身体换到另一处不会同时被淹的绿火旁。
These times are approximate. If your body is at the Lowlands fire, the flood disconnects you too. To remain after the inhabitants vanish, first move your body to a fire that will not flood at the same time.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_4_X4

### 外星站逃过爆炸，不等于逃过记忆回传 / Escaping the blast does not escape memory transmission
外星站自动驶出超新星范围。但只要灰烬双星计划仍运行，结束时仍会回传你的记忆；在绿火旁死亡解谜也没有自动关闭计划。
The Stranger moves beyond the supernova. While the Ash Twin Project remains active, it still transmits your memories; dying at a green fire does not disable the Project.
完成幽禁者相遇无需先取出高级核心。先停循环反而会改变死亡与等待的结果。
The Prisoner encounter does not require removing the advanced warp core. Disabling the loop changes what death and waiting do.
Source IDs: IP_ZONE_4_X4, TT_TIME_LOOP_DEVICE_X3, GD_STATUE_WORKSHOP_X2, IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X1

### 替代结局：被遗弃的世界 / Alternative ending: the abandoned world
先关闭灰烬双星计划，再留在驶出爆炸范围的现实外星站，等待终局文本出现。仅仅飞来外星站、保持循环开启，不会得到这个结局。
Disable the Ash Twin Project, then wait in the physical Stranger beyond the blast. Visiting with the loop still active does not trigger this ending.
你虽然躲过了超新星，却也失去了返回下一循环的机会，只能留在已被遗弃的外星站。下方保留结局的中英原文；英文明确说明你已在爆炸范围之外。
You survive the supernova but lose the chance to return to another loop, leaving you alone aboard the abandoned Stranger. The bilingual ending text below is preserved verbatim; the English makes clear that you are beyond the blast.
Source IDs: UI:814

### 替代结局：无法醒来的梦 / Alternative ending: unable to wake
先取出高级核心，带可用文物在绿火旁死亡并进入模拟世界，保持文物火焰且不要被终止连接，等待结局。
Remove the advanced warp core, connect by dying at a green fire with a working Artifact, and remain connected with its flame intact until the ending.
只有先关闭循环，才会走向这个无法醒来的结局。正常解封时保留灰烬双星计划，即使现实身体已死亡，仍会在记忆回传后开始下一轮。
This ending requires disabling the loop first. During normal exploration, the active Ash Twin Project still returns your memories after physical death, beginning another loop.
Source IDs: UI:815, IP_DREAM_2_RULE_X1
